name: p2p-observatory-chat
description: Strict P2P connectivity and chat diagnostics

scripts.dist:linux: npm run sync:web && npm run build:native && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux dir
scripts.dist:windows: npm run sync:web && npm run build:native && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win portable
scripts.android:add: npm run sync:web && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run sync:web && cap sync android
